description: This file contains implementation code for LXC container management within the WPEFramework, including classes for iterating network interfaces, managing container configurations, starting/stopping containers, and container administrator singleton logic.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces within an LXC container, providing methods to traverse, access, and count network interfaces.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container, providing methods to start, stop, retrieve info, and manage configuration.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config::ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents a configuration key-value pair for an LXC container, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Container configuration class holding console logging, config items, and optional attach flag.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing all LXC containers, providing creation, logging, and container lookup functionalities.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network interface, returns true if valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous network interface, returns true if valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator position to an initial state.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::~LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
methods.description: Destructor that frees allocated memory for interfaces.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::NumAddresses
methods.description: Returns the number of IP addresses for the current interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address at the specified index for the current interface.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Config::ConfigItem::ConfigItem
methods.description: Copy constructor for ConfigItem, copying key and value.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Config::ConfigItem::ConfigItem
methods.description: Default constructor for ConfigItem.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Config::Config
methods.description: Constructor initializing container configuration, including console logging and config items.

methods.name: LXCContainer::LXCContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing an LXC container object with configuration and environment inheritance.

methods.name: LXCContainer::~LXCContainer
methods.description: Destructor stopping the container if running and removing it from the administrator.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Id
methods.description: Returns the container's name.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information for the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU core usage information for the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the container's network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: LXCContainer::AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count and increases container's lifetime.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the container if count reaches zero.

methods.name: LXCContainer::InheritRequestedEnvironment
methods.description: Inherits environment variables from host into container configuration.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container by name from search paths.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Logging
methods.description: Configures logging for the container management system.
